rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root, not a candidate: the classical D^2-law with a population rate of 0.55 mm2/s, replaced by the prefix's own finite-difference rate as the prefix grows; no extinction, no cool flame and no evaporation. Carry of the baseline of flex_heptane-wsp-v4 (configs/models/flex/wsp4/heptane/baseline-d2) on the sixth droplet forward (droplet6.rs), new entries off: its assignment statements copied without change, and the entries flex_heptane-wsp-v5 adds (self-cooling evaporation of the unlit droplet, a dying flame, the cool-flame end in oxygen partial pressure) switched off (sc.on = 0, dy.frac = 0, ce.on = 0). Data-informed candidates of this spec are literal revisions of this release.
